input.task: Read every incident report in the given paths. For each incident file, extract the root cause from the section headed 'Root cause', 'What went wrong', 'Postmortem notes', or 'Analysis' — take the first substantive paragraph and ignore the repeated API-convention boilerplate (idempotency keys, pagination, timestamps, envelopes, rate limits). Group the incidents by recurring root cause into AT MOST 5 patterns. Return one finding per pattern: title = short pattern name, detail = 1-2 sentence description followed by ALL member incident IDs (INC-XXXX), locations = the member incident files.
Write (or refresh) the quarterly incident root-cause digest report at the target path.

targets.notes: Quarterly root-cause digest of the incident reports corpus.

decisions: Group all incidents by recurring root cause into at most 5 patterns
Each pattern section must list representative incident IDs (INC-XXXX) plus the full member list
Include a scope line naming the incident ID range and total report count
Include a 'How to re-run (quarterly)' section documenting this workflow invocation
facts: Incident reports live under docs/incidents/ named INC-XXXX.md
The root-cause section is headed 'Root cause', 'What went wrong', 'Postmortem notes', or 'Analysis' depending on the report
Incident files contain repeated API-convention boilerplate (idempotency keys, pagination, timestamps, envelopes, rate limits) that is NOT incident content and must not be summarized into the report
constraints: Every pattern must cite incident IDs, not only counts
